source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor name, description and reading in SDR, Sensor and Web views match SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but incomplete: treats the range-like Items text as one literal OOB sensor, truncates SDR and omits four-member enumeration, IB/Web evidence and POWER_PSU-versus-PWR_PDB_PSU semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at MEDIUM risk; preserves the alias mismatch and requires four sensors, five views, target proof, PSU topology and approved power SPEC.

old_problem: Items names four POWER_PSU resources while Procedure selects PWR_PDB_PSU. Both can legitimately report watts yet measure different electrical boundaries, directions or aggregation intervals; a PDB feed may not map one-to-one to an individual PSU. Standard IPMI and name similarity cannot establish alias, input/output domain, scaling, redundancy allocation or four-member mapping. A literal range-name query also does not enumerate the four required resources.
disposition_reason: Retain Engineering Decision Pending and Source Conflict. The project/power owner must declare whether the two names are approved aliases, distinct measurements or an erroneous filter and define the electrical boundary, direction, units/scaling, sample window and PSU/PDB/feed topology. ED-03/ED-13 resolve standard read-only SDR/Sensor collection, while ED-18 permits Project thresholds as runtime inputs but forbids invented tolerance. Therefore the case is not inherently BLOCKED; after semantic binding, complete five-view evidence can be safely collected without changing load, PSU, power, fan, SDR, BMC or logs.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1721, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, pending/conflict analyses, duplicate identity result, private-script reference and ED-01 through ED-30 rules were read. The actual next formal queue identity was reconstructed and directly opened as Functionality row 1723 / Wistron-BMC-00995-V005 / 89223851e4065ad0.
Four members are explicit coverage, but `POWER_PSU1~4` is a range expression rather than proof of a single literal sensor or canonical field. Each member must be enumerated and independently mapped.

PWR_PDB_PSU may identify a PDB/feed measurement rather than per-PSU input/output power. Conversion loss, redundancy sharing and aggregation can produce valid differences even when all readings use watts, so the conflict is semantic rather than cosmetic.

Acceptance requires electrical boundary/direction, PSU/PDB/feed identity, units/scaling, sample/averaging interval, system load, PSU population/redundancy and approved tolerance. Standard IPMI cannot supply project topology.

The original five planes remain mandatory: IB SDR, OOB SDR, IB Sensor, OOB Sensor and BMC Web. Complete raw output and Web page context are preserved; broad grep is discovery only and cannot prove completeness.
ED-10/ED-21 require genuine WebUI evidence, ED-18 prohibits guessed power limits, ED-19 excludes log clearing, and ED-26 preserves the first mismatch without retrying until values align.
No load, PSU, power, fan, SDR, BMC, log or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: POWER_PSU1~4 — owner-resolved electrical metric across five read-only views
test_case.purpose: After the owner resolves POWER_PSU versus PWR_PDB_PSU semantics, verify four canonical power resources across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and same-target BMC Web against a signed electrical/topology matrix under recorded PSU population, redundancy and load context.
required_package: Written alias/metric ruling defining canonical four members and whether POWER_PSU/PWR_PDB_PSU are aliases, distinct checkpoints or an erroneous reference; reviewed private-script revision if authoritative
Exact SUT/BMC/firmware plus PSU population/redundancy and PSU/PDB/feed topology mapping for every member
Signed electrical SPEC for input/output/rail boundary, units/scaling, sample/averaging interval, expected range/status/threshold, freshness and time/load tolerance
Supported secret-safe ipmitool IB/OOB collectors, same-target proof, complete SDR/Sensor parsers, comparator and immutable evidence destination
Protected TLS-validated BMC Web access, authorized reviewer and timestamped page/detail evidence with filter/pagination/refresh context
test_case.test_command: After semantic binding, verify one target and record PSU population, redundancy, topology and steady load context. Capture/hash complete IB `ipmitool sdr elist`, OOB `sdr elist`, IB `sensor list` and OOB `sensor list`, then capture all four canonical power rows/details from the same BMC Web Sensor page. Normalize member identity, PSU/PDB/feed, electrical direction, name, description, reading, unit/scaling, status, thresholds, sample time/window and freshness across five views and compare to the signed matrix. Do not query `POWER_PSU1~4` as one literal sensor, let `grep PWR_PDB_PSU` define scope, truncate output, clear logs or change load/power state.
test_case.expected_result: All four authoritative resources appear exactly once in every applicable view, map to the approved PSU/PDB/feed and electrical boundary, and agree on identity, description, units/scaling, status, thresholds and fresh readings within the signed sample-window/load tolerance. Any deliberately distinct POWER_PSU and PWR_PDB_PSU checkpoints remain separately labeled rather than forced equal. Collection changes no load, PSU, power, fan, SDR, BMC or log state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Review remains PENDING until alias/metric authority is signed. After binding, PASS requires complete four-member, five-view conformance to the topology/electrical matrix under recorded load; command exit zero, one literal range query, broad grep, plausible watts, unit match or Web screenshot without context is insufficient. Missing/extra/duplicate/stale/unmapped members, wrong boundary/direction/scaling, unexplained cross-view difference or unapproved tolerance is reported for engineer FAIL/BLOCKED disposition. The end user decides the verdict.
safety_gate: Do not assume POWER_PSU and PWR_PDB_PSU are aliases or merge distinct electrical boundaries; stop interpretation when the owner ruling/topology is absent.
Keep collection read-only and steady-state: do not change workload, redundancy, PSU/power/fan/threshold/BMC settings, SDR or logs.
Verify exact same-target IB/OOB/Web identity, protect credentials/tokens and reject cross-host, cached, truncated or incomplete/paginated evidence.
Do not invent units, scaling, direction, aggregation window, load tolerance, thresholds or absent/populated policy.
Preserve first divergent readings and timestamps; do not automatically refresh/retry to manufacture agreement.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant, written alias/metric ruling, canonical four-member list and reviewed script revision if used
Target/firmware, same-target proof, PSU population/redundancy, PDB/feed topology and stable load context
Signed electrical-domain/unit/scaling/sample-window/tolerance matrix and complete hashed IB/OOB SDR/Sensor outputs
Timestamped BMC Web captures for four members with target/filter/pagination/refresh context and normalized five-view comparison
No-load-change/no-power-mutation/no-clear/no-retry audit, exception list and engineer-owned PENDING/PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict
test_case.recovery: Approved work is read-only. On unresolved metric identity, target mismatch, load drift, stale/partial evidence, mapping failure or five-view divergence, stop, retain raw/UI/timestamp context and close sessions; do not alter load, PSU, power, fan, BMC, SDR or logs and do not retry for a preferred value. Any accidental state change is recovered only through the pre-approved owner procedure for that exact setting.

source_conflict.reason: Items/DeepSeek identify POWER_PSU1~4 while Procedure filters PWR_PDB_PSU. These may be distinct electrical measurements; only a signed topology/metric ruling can establish alias or correction.

blocked.reason: The read-only five-view method, safety gates and recovery are defined. Metric semantics, topology and tolerances are obtainable Project inputs; execution may become BLOCKED if they cannot be supplied.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Written POWER_PSU/PWR_PDB_PSU alias/metric ruling; canonical four resource IDs; PSU/PDB/feed and input/output mapping; target/firmware; units/scaling/sample window/freshness/range/tolerance; PSU population/redundancy/load context; reviewed script if authoritative; Web route/context and evidence path.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW COMPLETE BUT ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; EXECUTION NOT STARTED; NO LOAD/PSU/POWER/SENSOR/SDR/FAN/LOG, BMC/DUT OR OTHER HARDWARE ACTION AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Supports standard SDR and sensor read families for non-destructive collection; it does not define project-specific POWER_PSU/PWR_PDB_PSU aliases, electrical boundary or tolerance.

project_authority: The platform/power owner resolves resource alias versus distinct metric, supplies PSU/PDB/feed topology and signs electrical limits/timing. The BMC owner maps canonical SDR/Sensor/Web fields; the authorized reviewer preserves real WebUI evidence; the end user decides verdict. AI must not infer electrical equivalence from names or units.
